Name: Event Statues
Author: Nullnnow
Description:
Tired of waiting to get that second owl statue? Got more Galaxy Souls than you know what to do with? Well the wizard has got you covered!

The mod adds 5 new buildings that can be built by the wizard. By giving the building a Galaxy Soul, you can attempt to force a random event to occur. The buildings added are as follows:
[list]
[*]Crashed UFO - Used to spawn the strange capsule event.
[*]Fairy Garden - Used to spawn the crop fairy event.
[*]Meteor Statue - Used to spawn the meteorite event.
[*]Witch Statue - Used to spawn the witch event.
[*]King Owl Statue - Used to spawn the owl statue event.
[/list]
[b]Plans for the Future
[/b][list]
[*]I plan on adding a statue that can summon the green rain event! This statue will also be used to summon similar events added by another mod I plan on working on in the near future.
[*]I dislike the mixels on the UFO. Unfortunately, redrawing it to scale is a massive pain.
[/list]
